description: Interface test call: one existing remote-enabled function module of an interface mapping specification, called with parameters the user reviewed (handler ZCL_MCP_BIZ_IF, 7.40 / S/4HANA, development clients only). Used by the /interfaces 인터페이스 테스트 button. channel web: the assist chat never lists or matches it (scripts/assist/catalog.mjs).

en: call the RFC of the interface spec

params.name: fm_name
params.note: the remote-enabled function module of the specification (Z*, Y* or BAPI_*)

params.name: fm_params
params.note: one JSON object as text: parameter names in upper case, structures as objects, tables as arrays

params.name: ack_posting
params.note: true: the user confirmed the module may post or commit data (required when the preview shows posting signs)

params.name: commit
params.note: true: BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT after the call; otherwise the call is rolled back

en: The preview checks the parameters against the signature and reads the module's own source for posting signs; it does not run the module.
Posting in modules the function calls is not seen; a module that commits by itself cannot be rolled back.
ko: 미리보기는 시그니처와 파라미터를 대조하고 모듈 자체 소스에서 전기 흔적만 찾아요. 모듈을 실행하지는 않아요.
모듈이 부르는 다른 모듈의 전기는 보이지 않아요. 스스로 커밋하는 모듈은 되돌릴 수 없어요.

ECC.fm: the specification's function module (dynamic CALL FUNCTION, PARAMETER-TABLE)
ECC.preview: signature (FUPARAREF), parameter names / required importing parameters / types (/UI2/CL_JSON into RTTI data), posting signs (name; COMMIT WORK, IN UPDATE TASK, database writes in its own source); nothing is called
ECC.commit: BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT (WAIT) only with commit = true and no E / A message; otherwise ROLLBACK WORK in the same LUW
ECC.return: BAPIRET* parameters, classic exceptions, ERROR_MESSAGE; exporting / changing / tables parameters as JSON; document numbers
ECC.note: 7.40 and later only (/UI2/CL_JSON); not installed on 7.31. Development (customizing) clients only: T000-CCCATEGORY C.

S4.fm: the specification's function module (dynamic CALL FUNCTION, PARAMETER-TABLE)
S4.preview: as on ECC: signature, parameters, posting signs; nothing is called
S4.commit: BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT (WAIT) only with commit = true and no E / A message; otherwise ROLLBACK WORK in the same LUW
